newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac raps left, appeals for French support.
newsitem.headline: Chirac raps left, appeals for French support.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac, jumping into the parliamentary election fray, launched a frontal attack on the record and proposals of France's left-wing opposition and appealed for voters' support in an increasingly tight race.

In an article in regional newspapers marking the second anniversary of his election on Wednesday, the conservative president urged the French people not to turn their backs on the course of history in the snap poll he has called for May 25 and June 1 but to vote for political stability.
